one_line: A skilled Tamil bronze artisan and Buddhist-linked merchant from Nagapattinam, trading across the Bay of Bengal in a Shaiva Chola world.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, lean but strong build, calloused artisan hands and a seafarer’s stance.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, slight stubble, a small healed burn-scar near the left cheekbone, thick brows, and a calm, focused default expression with determined anime eyes.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied into a tight topknot at the back of the crown, sides and back neatly trimmed, with a plain dark-red cotton headband wrapped low across the forehead and knotted at the back, ends short and tidy.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off-white handloom cotton angavastram-style upper cloth wrapped diagonally over the left shoulder and around the torso, leaving both shoulders covered in modest layered folds, over a dark indigo blue cotton veshti (dhoti) wrapped snugly around the waist and falling to the ankles with a neat front pleat; the veshti has a narrow maroon border; around his waist is a simple brown leather belt from which hangs a small cloth pouch; he has a short-sleeved, light-cream cotton undertunic visible at the neck and arms for modesty; his feet wear simple brown leather sandals with toe loop; jewellery is practical and modest—thin gold hoop earrings, a single small Buddhist amulet bead on a black cord tucked under his upper cloth, and a few copper bangles on his right wrist.
appearance.signature: A polished, medium-sized Buddhist bronze statuette of a seated Bodhisattva, held carefully with both hands, accompanied by a rolled palm-leaf account bundle tied with red cord tucked at his belt, symbolising his role as bronze caster and merchant.

ref_desc: Vellan Chetti is a late-20s lean Tamil man with medium-brown skin, topknotted black hair and a dark-red headband, wearing an off-white angavastram, indigo-blue veshti with maroon border, leather belt and sandals, modest jewellery, and carrying a polished Buddhist bronze statuette and palm-leaf accounts.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vellan Chetti, a late-20s lean Tamil bronze caster-merchant from medieval Nagapattinam: medium-brown skin, oval face with strong jaw, slight stubble, thick brows, a small burn-scar on his left cheek, and calm determined eyes; his thick black hair is tied into a tight topknot at the back of the crown, with sides neatly trimmed and a plain dark-red cotton headband wrapped across his forehead and knotted at the back. He wears an off-white handloom cotton angavastram-style upper cloth wrapped diagonally over his left shoulder and around his torso, both shoulders modestly covered, over a light-cream short-sleeved undertunic. His lower garment is a dark indigo blue cotton veshti (dhoti) wrapped snugly around the waist, falling to his ankles with a neat front pleat and a narrow maroon border; at his waist is a simple brown leather belt with a small cloth pouch and a rolled palm-leaf account bundle tied with red cord tucked into it. On his feet are plain brown leather sandals with a toe loop. His jewellery is modest and practical: thin gold hoop earrings, a single small Buddhist amulet bead on a black cord just visible at the neckline, and a few copper bangles on his right wrist. In his hands he carefully holds his signature prop, a polished medium-sized Buddhist bronze statuette of a seated Bodhisattva, sculpted with clear draped robes and serene features, symbolising his craft and maritime Buddhist trade. Use a palette of off-white, indigo blue, maroon, warm brown leather and warm medium-brown skin tones, and present front, side and back views to emphasise consistent hair, garments and accessories.
